kid's.line: And their kid's not back from that party yet
stanza: No one laughs at God in a hospital
No one laughs at God in a war
When they're starving or freezing or so very poor
When the doctor calls after some routine tests
And their kid's not back from that party yet
When their airplane starts to uncontrollably shake
When they see the one they love, hand in hand with someone else
And they hope that they're mistaken
When the cops knock on their door, and they say, "We've got some bad news, sir"
When there's a famine, a fire or a flood
